source.robosuite_reference_status: REFERENCE_ONLY_NOT_EXECUTED; contains a pre-existing macros.py edit and untracked mujoco.dll that must be preserved

contact_graph.robot_exclusion: Resolve every geom named by every robot model contact_geoms set to geom IDs; discard a contact if either geom ID is in that union.
contact_graph.node: Canonical MuJoCo mobility body: map a geom body to its nearest ancestor that owns a joint; if none exists, map it to the highest named body below world. Collapse all geoms with the same canonical body.
contact_graph.node_type: free if the body or an ancestor below world has a free joint; articulated if it has a hinge or slide joint; static otherwise.
contact_graph.retained_edge: An unordered non-self body pair with neither endpoint robot-associated and at least one endpoint typed free or articulated.
contact_graph.transition_labels: For every supported edge type, separate birth and death bits between consecutive stable graphs.
contact_graph.debounce: An edge state must persist for two consecutive recorded states before its stable state changes; assign the transition to the first state in the new two-state run.

stage0a_label_gate.purpose: Establish exact replay, auditable robot exclusion, noncollapsed typed transitions, and signal not reducible to gripper timing before any probe or method.
stage0a_label_gate.process_isolation: One task environment at a time; close and release it before the next task.

stage0b_headroom_gate.rows: The same frozen tasks and demos; transition at state t is paired to the six-dimensional arm action at t-1 and features available through t-1.

visual_probe.inputs: Agent and wrist RGB at t-1 and t resized to 64x64, robot state through t-1, two previous actions, and normalized time; no contact, reward, done, or success input.
visual_probe.architecture: Four convolution blocks with channels 16,32,64,64, 3x3 kernels, ReLU and group normalization, global average pooling, then a 64-unit fusion MLP.
visual_probe.optimizer: AdamW, learning rate 3e-4, weight decay 1e-4, batch 128, maximum 20 epochs.
visual_probe.selection: Choose epoch on development_tune only; report the median of three frozen seeds on validation.
controls: nonvisual proprio-action-time probe with the same fusion width

oracle_action_headroom.target: actions[t-1,0:6] on plus-or-minus-two-frame debounced transition boundaries
oracle_action_headroom.estimator: Standardized ridge regression with alpha selected from [0.0001,0.001,0.01,0.1,1,10,100] on development_tune only.
oracle_action_headroom.base_features: Robot state at t-1, actions through t-2 for two steps, and normalized time.
controls: base plus gripper-change and coarse temporal stage
oracle_action_headroom.full: Strongest control plus the typed birth/death topology vector.
oracle_action_headroom.shuffle: Fifty root-seed-derived within-demo permutations of the typed topology vector.

decision_logic: Stage0A failure archives this formulation and activates Backup 2. Stage0A GO authorizes only Stage0B. Stage0B GO authorizes only a separately frozen method contract and official Base/comparator plan. Neither decision authorizes paper generation.
